messages:
nina: quick q — i opened a PR that touches `tools/monorepo-scripts` and `runtime/helpers`. it also updates a CODEOWNERS entry. who can actually approve this? unsure if we need cross-team signoff.
ryan: if CODEOWNERS lists eng-platform for `tools/` then eng-platform approval should be enough for that path. runtime/helpers probably owned by eng-runtime though. did you modify runtime logic or just helpers?
sam: @nina can you paste the PR link? easier to eyeball. also include the diff for CODEOWNERS since that can change who gets auto-requested.
nina: here — <https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/pr/987|PR #987>

nina: small helper changes (no behavior change) + a line in `CODEOWNERS` to add `/tools/monorepo-scripts` -> @eng-platform. i split the change into one commit for helpers and one for CODEOWNERS but kept them in same PR to avoid 2 deploys.
deploy-bot: [auto] PR opened by nina: redwood/pr/987 — files: 4 changed, 2 additions to CODEOWNERS, 1 modified helper file. CI: pending.
maya: hmm mixing CODEOWNERS and runtime touch in same PR makes the approval path fuzzy. usually we prefer splitting, but if the runtime change is trivial we can handle it. @ryan are you comfortable approving runtime/helpers?
ryan: i can review the helpers. if it's just refactor/no-behavior change i'm fine approving, but i want another runtime pair on the PR for safety. @jordan can you glance or assign someone from runtime?
jordan: i can quick-check today. if it's nonblocking we can approve both in one go, but prefer note in the PR description stating it's safe to merge after both LGTM. also: please add a canary plan in the PR body.
nina: will do — adding `Canary: deploy to staging for 30m, smoke tests, rollback if regressions`. also leaving the runtime reviewer tag.
sam: tiny suggestion — move the CODEOWNERS edit to a separate commit with message `chore: add tools/monorepo-scripts to CODEOWNERS` so blamelogs are clear.
nina: okay done, split commit and updated PR description. CI passed on linux, mac. windows still flaky but unrelated.
ryan: i'll run a quick review now. if looks ok i'll approve and add `:shipit:` reaction.
jordan: gave a couple nits but nothing blocking. 
maya: if ryan approves, eng-platform can own the CODEOWNERS change. runtime will acknowledge the helper change — no need for extra signoff after jordan's check.
ryan: reviewed and approved. leaving the review now. :shipit:
nina: thanks all — i'll merge after the ci run finishes and kick a staging canary. will ping here if anything odd during canary.
ryan: nice. one more ask — if rollback needed, please make sure the fleet-rollout tag is on the PR.
nina: noted and added `fleet-rollout: canary` label. will report back. :thumbsup:
